deity.name: Abundantia
deity.description: divine personification of wealth and prosperity

deity.name: Aequitas
deity.description: divine personification of fairness

deity.name: Aeternitas
deity.description: divine personification of eternity

deity.name: Annona
deity.description: divine personification of the grain supply to the city of Rome

deity.name: Apollo
deity.description: god of poetry, music, and oracles, and one of the Dii Consentes (twelve major deities)

deity.name: Artemis
deity.description: Greek goddess of the hunt, the wilderness, nature, childbirth, care of children, and chastity

deity.name: Athena
deity.description: Greek goddess of wisdom, war, the arts, industries and trades

deity.name: Bonus Eventus
deity.description: divine personification of 'good outcome'

deity.description: known as Gemini, semi-divine twin half-brothers, sons of Jupiter; credited with the role of saving those in trouble at sea or in danger in war

deity.name: Concordia
deity.description: goddess of agreement, understanding, and marital harmony

deity.name: Constantinopolis
deity.description: divine personification of the city of Constantinople

deity.name: Diana
deity.description: goddess of the hunt, the moon, virginity, and childbirth, twin sister of Apollo and one of the Dii Consentes (twelve major deities)

deity.name: Euphrates
deity.description: river god of Euphrates

deity.name: Fecunditas
deity.description: divine personification of fertility

deity.name: Felicitas

deity.name: Fides
deity.description: divine personification of loyalty

deity.name: Fortuna
deity.description: goddess of fortune

deity.name: Genius
deity.description: protecting spirit or divinity of each individual

deity.name: Hera
deity.description: Greek goddess of marriage, women and family

deity.name: Hercules
deity.description: god of strength, whose worship was derived from the Greek hero Heracles, but took on a distinctly Roman character

deity.name: Hercules Deusoniensis
deity.description: germanic god, appearence of Donar (Thor) as Hercules

deity.name: Honos
deity.description: divine personification of honor

deity.name: Indulgentia
deity.description: devine personification of indulgence, goodness, kindness

deity.description: queen of gods, epithet 'Lucina' - goddess of light and childbirth; one of the Dii Consentes (twelve major deities)

deity.name: Juno Moneta
deity.description: queen of gods, epithet 'Moneta' - divine protectress of funds and mint; one of the Dii Consentes (twelve major deities)

deity.name: Juno Regina
deity.description: queen of gods, epithet 'Regina' - the Queen; one of the Dii Consentes (twelve major deities)

deity.name: Jupiter
deity.description: king of gods, god of storms, lightning, sky, and one of the Dii Consentes (twelve major deities)

deity.name: Laetitia
deity.description: divine personification of joy and happiness

deity.name: Liberalitas
deity.description: goddess or divine personification of generosity

deity.name: Libertas
deity.description: goddess or divine personification of freedom

deity.name: Mars
deity.description: god of war and father of Romulus, the founder of Rome; one of the Dii Consentes (twelve major deities)

deity.name: Minerva
deity.description: goddess of wisdom, war, the arts, industries and trades, and one of the Dii Consentes (twelve major deities)

deity.name: Neptune
deity.description: god of the sea, earthquakes, and horses, and one of the Dii Consentes (twelve major deities)

deity.name: Nike
deity.description: Greek goddess of victory

deity.name: Pan
deity.description: god of the wild, shepherds and rustic music

deity.name: Pax
deity.description: goddess of peace

deity.name: Persephone
deity.description: Greek goddess of spring growth, daughter of Zeus; queen of the underworld, wife of Hades

deity.name: Pietas
deity.description: goddess of duty; divine personification of the Roman virtue pietas ('duty', 'religiosity', 'loyalty')

deity.name: Providentia
deity.description: goddess of foresight

deity.name: Pudicitia
deity.description: goddess and divine personification of chastity (purity), one of the Roman virtues

deity.name: Roma
deity.description: divine personification of the Roman state

deity.name: Romulus
deity.description: the founder of Rome; son of Mars

deity.name: Salus
deity.description: goddess of safety and well-being (welfare, health and prosperity) of the Roman people

deity.name: Securitas
deity.description: goddess of security, especially the security of the Roman state

deity.name: Serapis
deity.description: Graeco-Egyptian deity of the sun, derived from the Egyptian Osiris and Apis

deity.name: Sol Invictus
deity.description: god of the sun; invincible

deity.name: Spes
deity.description: goddess of hope

deity.name: Tyche
deity.description: Greek goddess of fortune and prosperity

deity.name: Venus
deity.description: goddess of love, beauty, sexuality, and gardens; mother of the founding hero Aeneas; one of the Dii Consentes (twelve major deities)

deity.name: Vesta
deity.description: goddess of the hearth (firepace), the Roman state, and the sacred fire; one of the Dii Consentes (twelve major deities)

deity.name: Victoria
deity.description: goddess of victory

deity.name: Virtus
deity.description: god or goddess of military strength, divine personification of the Roman virtue of virtus (valor, manliness, courage)

deity.name: Zeus
deity.description: Greek god of the sky and thunder
